card.name: Word-start F after a preceding word
card.fires_on: Mostly the letter F (or f) split off as the start of a longer word, such as FDI, fumigation, fowl, flobberworms, ferry, Fetal. Also fires occasionally on small words like a or of before a noun.

modes.label: Lone F starting a word
modes.description: The letter F stands alone as the first piece of a word that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: Traders protest against govt policies on<< F>>DI, FTA

modes.label: Small word before a noun
modes.description: A short word like a, of, or ones is marked just before a noun phrase.
modes.example: Xavier had raised<< a>> man from the dead.

card.writes: It pushes toward word beginnings like ma, sil and silver, mostly non-English pieces, with no clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up when a word starts with a separate letter F, as in Fetal or fumigation.
